items.q: How much is the room rate per night?
items.a: Room rates start from IDR 200,000/night for Single Bed and IDR 250,000/night for Double Bed. Includes AC, WiFi, 32" Android TV, and amenities.
Single Bed can accommodate up to 2 adults + 1 infant. Double Bed can accommodate up to 3 adults + 1 infant. Infants are not counted as adult guests during reservation.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: Reservations can be made via WhatsApp at 0818 232 021. Just send your name and desired stay dates. We will reply quickly.
Yes, breakfast is available by request for an additional IDR 25,000 per pack/person. Contact the receptionist to order.
Yes, extra beds and pillows are available for an additional IDR 50,000 per room. Please inform us during reservation.

Wisma Apollo is suitable for government trips, project workers, sales teams, families, and guests who need a place to rest after an overland journey. The atmosphere is quiet, reservations are easy through WhatsApp, and rooms are prepared so guests can rest comfortably as soon as they arrive.

paragraphs: Each room is equipped with air conditioning, a 32-inch Android TV, free WiFi, a private bathroom with shower, clean towels, bathroom amenities, a comfortable spring bed, and soundproof walls and ceiling for a quieter rest.

Guests also receive mineral water, coffee, and tea every day. Spacious parking, a calm environment, and helpful reception support make Wisma Apollo comfortable for both short stays and several nights.

If you need a hotel in Kuala Kurun that is practical, transparent in price, and still comfortable for a good night of sleep, Wisma Apollo deserves to be on your shortlist.
